scope: Public, synthetic, isolated Ollama qualification only; no private Factory code, credentials, production or commercial inference service.

decisions.public_standard_runner_minutes: PASS: GitHub documents standard hosted runners as free for public repositories; does not imply paid runners or storage are free.
decisions.public_runner_hardware: PASS_DOCUMENTED: ubuntu-latest public 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 14 GB SSD, x64. Actual memory/disk availability must be measured during a job.
decisions.job_duration: PASS_DOCUMENTED: hosted job hard maximum 6 hours; not persistent.
decisions.public_runner_for_project_related_synthe: CONDITIONAL_PASS: GitHub terms permit development/testing associated with repository; still require bounded low-burden job and no artifact/cache overage.
decisions.public_runner_as_general_purpose_commerc: FAIL_POLICY: GitHub Additional Product Terms disallow using Actions as an application/service or unrelated to repository software development; do not repurpose public runners as permanent AI backend.
decisions.account_specific_storage_billing: UNKNOWN: artifact/package storage can accrue charges; prohibit artifacts, caches and paid features until account-specific budget verified.
decisions.qwen2_5_coder_0_5b: PASS_LICENSE: Ollama registry tag 0.5b Apache-2.0, download ~398 MB; CPU inference not yet verified.
decisions.qwen2_5_coder_1_5b: PASS_LICENSE: Ollama registry tag 1.5b Apache-2.0, download ~986 MB; CPU inference not yet verified.
decisions.qwen2_5_coder_3b: DENY_UNTIL_LICENSE_REVIEW: Ollama registry lists Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT; do not treat as Apache-2.0.
decisions.qwen2_5_coder_7b: PASS_LICENSE_ONLY: Ollama tag 7b Apache-2.0, ~4.7 GB download; memory/performance and practical runner fit UNKNOWN.
decisions.ollama_runtime: PASS_SOFTWARE_LICENSE: Ollama source MIT; specific model weights have independent licenses.
decisions.private_data_isolation: PASS_DESIGN_ONLY: public workflow may run only synthetic/public inputs, no private source or secrets. Existing Night Shift workflow contains secret references and must not be reused for Ollama qualification without independent security review.
decisions.actual_ollama_inference: NOT_VERIFIED: no real model inference executed in this loop.
decisions.worker_integration: NOT_ADMITTED: Flint and Groq remain unchanged; Ollama is add-only and not operational.

recommended_next_edge: Loop 3: create a bounded, manually dispatched development/test-only synthetic inference probe in the EXISTING public repo, after verifying exact workflow and safe permissions. Never run it as a commercial/production worker.
Probe only qwen2.5-coder:0.5b first, with strict timeout, disk/memory measurements, no secrets, no artifacts or cache, permissions: contents:read, no reusable private-controller workflow.
Loop 4: independently verify observed model response, memory, time, exit status, test outputs, no data leakage, and terms compliance.
Loop 5: prohibit using GitHub-hosted runners as permanent backend; investigate separate genuinely zero-cost authorized worker hosting if 24x7 inference remains necessary.
